sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: ArchDaily invites you to the launch of the 6th edition of its Next Practices Awards . Taking place during Design Week Mexico , the event will explore how emerging practices are expanding architecture's capacity to act and produce change: from the tools and knowledge they work with to the social, environmental, cultural, and material realities they engage with.
